# `gcp.targettcpproxy`

Represents a TargetTcpProxy resource, which is used by one or more global forwarding rule to route incoming TCP requests to a Backend service.

[compute](README.md) · [all services](../README.md)

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Service | compute |
| Scope | global |
| Asset type | `compute.googleapis.com/TargetTcpProxy` |
| Tier | 1 (generic-safe) |
| Mutation timeout | 600s |
